sections.title: Network & Security
instructions: • iOS (iPhone & iPad): Scan the QR code in Safari, tap the Share button ( ↑ ) → 'Add to Home Screen', and launch full-screen.
• Android: Download and install the native Iris.apk companion app below, or open in Chrome → 'Add to Home screen'.
• Dynamic IP & Reconnection: If your PC's IP address changes, simply scan the live QR code above to reconnect immediately.
• Reliable Setup: For the most seamless connection, reserve this PC's local IP address in your router's DHCP reservation settings.
